title: Where are we?
author: Calm-You-4757
selftext:
Welcome to one of your first insights into the great world of Anthropos! We have been building WORLDS: Anthropos for five years. Our game is a top-down sci-fi RPG with a wishlist page up, and a launch date of Nov 2027!

AI disclosure: we use AI tools for early concept drafts, and to aid in writing new code. All in-game art is made by lead-dev, Anthony, and Maya is voiced by voice actor Autumn Teague.



We're more than happy to answer anything about how we make our game. Follow us as we approach full launch!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Calm-You-4757 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
